# Verify the submitted answer: *dəpa -> "tapɨ" in Phan Rang Cham (PRC).
# Method: collect attested PRC reflexes of the same source shape (disyllabic,
# open final *-a), check the onset and medial correspondences, then test
# which final-vowel reflexes the data supports. No files, no network, stdlib only.

# (Proto-Chamic, Phan Rang Cham) pairs with the same shape as *dəpa: disyllabic, open final *-a
analogs = [
    ("*bara", "pirà"),    # CVCa, stressed final
    ("*lima", "limɨ"),    # CVCa, reduced final
    ("*mata", "mɨta"),    # CVCa, final a retained
]

# Onset/medial correspondences attested elsewhere in the table
onset_pairs = [("*dikiʔ", "takiʔ"), ("*dilah", "talàh"), ("*dəpa", None)]
medial_pairs = [("*bəsey", "pathey"), ("*basah", "pathah"), ("*padam", "patàm")]

def onset(form):
    return form[0]

# Check the initial *d- -> t- correspondence (no p- from *d-)
d_initial = [p for p, _ in onset_pairs if p.startswith("*d")]
d_reflexes = [r for p, r in onset_pairs if r is not None and p.startswith("*d")]
print("Initial *d- sources:", d_initial)
print("Initial reflexes:", [onset(r) for r in d_reflexes])
initial_ok = all(onset(r) == "t" for r in d_reflexes)
print("CHECK PASS: *d- -> t- in PRC" if initial_ok else "CHECK FAIL: *d- -> t- not uniform")

# Medial *p -> p in PRC (from *padam -> patàm; *bubah -> papàh is also a p-medial example)
medial_p_ok = all("p" in r for _, r in medial_pairs if "p" in r) and "patàm" in [r for _, r in medial_pairs]
print("Medial p retained (patàm):", medial_p_ok)

# Stem onset+medial prediction for *dəpa: t-a-p-...
stem_prediction = "tap"
print("Predicted stem:", stem_prediction)

# Final vowel: enumerate candidate reflexes and compare against the analogs
candidates = ["tapa", "tapà", "tapɨ"]
final_vowels = {}
for src, r in analogs:
    final_vowels[src] = r[-1]
print("Final-vowel reflexes in analogs:", final_vowels)

# The analogs split: *bara -> à, *lima -> ɨ, *mata -> a.
# The data does not single out one final vowel for *dəpa.
supported = {c: [src for src, r in analogs if r[-1] == c[-1]] for c in candidates}
print("Analog support per candidate:", supported)

submitted = "tapɨ"
if submitted in candidates and len(set(final_vowels.values())) > 1:

          "; other analogs favor 'à' or 'a'.")
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN: the data does not uniquely determine the final vowel of tapɨ.")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL: submitted form not among candidates.")

print("UNSUPPORTED: stress-dependent final-vowel reduction in PRC cannot be settled from this table alone.")
